topic: Handling of devices and assemblies and Electrical testing precaution
syllabus_extract: Handling of devices and assemblies and Electrical testing precaution.
specific_objectives: 24.15.1.1 Trainee will be able to follow Electrostatic sensitive device handling practices in a workshop.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of ESD wrist strap connection and verification using a test meter; Instructor supervision of trainee donning wrist straps and handling ESD sensitive components on a grounded workbench.
intro_questions: What is the primary risk of static electricity to electronic components?
Why must a workbench be grounded before handling sensitive devices?
What personal protective equipment is required for ESD sensitive work?

summary_questions: Explain the correct method for donning an ESD wrist strap.
List three critical precautions to take before performing electrical testing.
Describe the immediate action required if a device shows signs of ESD damage.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report outlining the specific steps required to set up a compliant Special Handling Area for storage, as covered in the next lesson plan.
